semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides laser equipment and SMT manufacturing and inspection equipment, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LaserTek Taiwan Co., Ltd is a multinational manufacturer specializing in laser equipment and surface mount technology (SMT) manufacturing and inspection equipment. The company offers SMD tape and reel services, focusing on optoelectronic technology to serve niche markets. It collaborates with industry partners to enhance its service capabilities.
